sources.title: North Macedonia Ministry of Interior: citizen passport service
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior of the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Interior Ministry citizen-services page supplies the normal passport procedure for North Macedonian citizens, separately from its emergency travel-document information; it is the origin-document scope for the ordinary citizen passport in this candidate.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The passport in regular procedure is issued within 15 days from the day of submitting the application.

sources.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina MFA: entry with passport or ID card
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Bosnia and Herzegovina
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Bosnia and Herzegovina MFA visa page expressly includes North Macedonia among the nationalities that may enter with a passport or a valid identity card; its linked official visa decision fixes the visa-free short-stay period.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Nationals ... North Macedonia ... may enter into Bosnia and Herzegovina with a passport or a valid identity card proving identity and citizenship.

sources.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina Border Police: North Macedonia passport or ID entry
sources.publisher: Border Police of Bosnia and Herzegovina
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Border Police FAQ expressly identifies Macedonia among nationalities that may use a valid identity card in addition to a travel document for entry, exit, transit and a 90-day stay; the MFA's current visa page separately identifies North Macedonia in that group.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Macedonia ... may enter, exit, transit and stay in Bosnia and Herzegovina for 90 days in any 180-day period.

sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service: 2026 Tourism (F5A) visa service level
sources.officialityEvidence: Nigeria Immigration Service's April 2026 service-level document describes the F5A tourism eVisa as available to citizens of all countries and says the visa certificate is sent by email.
sources.supportingExcerpt: F5A- TOURISM VISA ... Eligibility: Citizens of all countries ... Receive Visa certificate via email.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea Government: online visa is operational
sources.publisher: Government of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea Information and Press Office
sources.officialityEvidence: The live institutional Government page identifies itself as the Government of Equatorial Guinea and directly confirms that the equatorialguinea-evisa.com portal is operational for visitors to obtain visas online without an in-person visit.
sources.supportingExcerpt: todos los interesados en viajar al país podrán conseguir su visado sin tener que desplazarse físicamente.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: eligibility and electronic delivery
sources.officialityEvidence: The portal's authenticity and online-visa purpose are anchored by the current Government Information and Press Office announcement that directs visitors to this exact domain. Its FAQ supplies the all-nationality scope and emailed/PDF issuance mechanics.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All Nationalities can apply for an E-Visa ... All E-Visa are sent by email.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: regular-passport application process
sources.officialityEvidence: The portal's authenticity is anchored by the live Government announcement linking to this exact service. Its current process requires the travel passport to match the application and excludes non-regular travel documents.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The only travel document that can be used ... is your regular passport.

policies.title: North Macedonian ordinary passports: Bosnia and Herzegovina visa-free short visit
policies.summary: Bosnia and Herzegovina's current official entry sources expressly permit North Macedonian nationals to use a passport or valid identity card for visa-free entry, exit, transit and stays of up to 90 days in any 180 days.
conditions: Use the regular North Macedonian citizen passport. Bosnia and Herzegovina also permits the qualifying national identity card, but this policy records the passport route only.

The current Border Police guidance permits entry, exit, transit and a short stay of up to 90 days in any 180-day period. Work, residence, special documents, border routes, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: North Macedonian ordinary passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism route accepts citizens of all countries and sends the tourism visa certificate by email before travel.
conditions: Apply online using a valid North Macedonian ordinary passport with the F5A tourism supporting documents and payment; the visitor route is single entry for up to 30 days.
The emailed visa certificate is electronic issuance before travel, not online preapproval followed by border issuance.

Nigeria excepts ECOWAS States and countries with a visa-waiver agreement. Its current document does not identify a North Macedonian ordinary-passport waiver; the all-country eVisa route is therefore retained with medium confidence.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service tourism eVisa
steps: Apply online with the North Macedonian ordinary passport and stated tourism documents.
Pay and receive the visa certificate by email before departure.
Present the certificate and supporting documents for carrier and final-admission checks.

policies.title: North Macedonian ordinary passports: Equatorial Guinea electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Equatorial Guinea's authenticated live eVisa service accepts all nationalities using a regular passport and sends the eVisa by email as a PDF before travel.
conditions: Use the same valid regular North Macedonian citizen passport for application and travel; non-regular travel documents are not accepted.

Apply through the authenticated eVisa service and receive the eVisa by email in PDF form before travel. The final visa-on-arrival stamp mentioned for arrival does not alter the pre-travel electronic issuance.
The ordinary visitor route does not establish work, residence, special-document, carrier or final-admission entitlement.

application.label: Equatorial Guinea eVisa service
steps: Apply online using the regular North Macedonian passport for travel.
Receive and retain the emailed PDF eVisa before departure.
Present the same passport and eVisa at arrival for immigration processing and final admission.
